suggested_requirements.text: The system shall allow a general user to monitor and control the home environment.
The Master user shall be able to add a user account.
The Master user shall be able to change default parameter settings.
The DH Technician shall be able to set up and maintain the system configuration.
The DH Technician shall be able to start and stop the operation of the DH System.
The DH system shall establish an individual home web server hosted on a home computer.
The DH web server shall provide interaction with and control of the DH elements.
The DH web server shall provide storage of DH plans and data.
The DH web server shall provide backup service for user account information, user plans, and a home database.
The DH Gateway device shall provide communication with all DigitalHome devices.
The DH Gateway device shall connect with a broadband Internet connection.
The Gateway shall send and receive wireless communications between the Gateway and other DigitalHome devices.
The system shall include digital programmable thermostats to monitor and regulate temperature.
The thermostat shall provide a reading of the current temperature.
The thermostat shall provide a set point temperature to control heating or cooling devices.
The system shall include digital programmable humidistats to monitor and regulate humidity.
The humidistat shall provide a reading of the current humidity.
The humidistat shall provide a set point humidity to control humidifiers and dehumidifiers.
The system shall include magnetic alarm contact switches to monitor entry through doors or windows.
The system shall include security sound and light alarms that activate upon a security breach.
The system shall include digital programmable power switches to monitor the state of an appliance.
The system shall be able to change the state of an appliance via a power switch.
The system shall allow a web-ready device to control temperature, humidity, lights, security, and appliance states.
The system shall save sensor values in the home database.
The system shall send controller values to controllers to change the environment.
The thermostat shall allow a user to set temperatures between 60°F and 80°F in one-degree increments.
The system shall support Fahrenheit and Celsius temperature values.
The humidistat shall allow a user to set humidity levels between 30% and 60% in 1% increments.
The system shall manage up to fifty door and window contact sensors.
The system shall manage up to one hundred 115 volt, 10 amp power switches.
The system shall provide a monthly planner for setting environmental parameters.
The system shall provide a report on home management and control for any month in the past two years.
Displays of environmental conditions shall be updated at least every two seconds.
Sensors shall have a minimum data acquisition rate of 10 Hz.
The Gateway device shall operate up to a 1000-foot range for indoor transmission.
The system shall have no more than 1 failure per 10,000 hours of operation.
The system shall backup all system data on a daily basis.
The system shall restore system data from the most recent backup upon failure.
The system shall provide a clear, descriptive message when an error or exceptional condition occurs.
The web system shall provide authentication and information encryption.
